title: occurrences
description: A recurring task's occurrences in a range, exactly as GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}/occurrences returns them (OpenSpec series-occurrences). Dates only, no content.

capped.description: the range holds more than the 31 projected occurrences listed

tz.description: the series' IANA zone, when its due names one

state.description: current and projected occurrences, or one with a record (series-exceptions): open (moved or edited), done or skipped, by the date it stands for

due.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the record's due date when it was moved to another day
